evidence.snippet: To authenticate requests to the Twilio APIs, Twilio supports HTTP Basic authentication
Use your API key SID as the username and your API key secret as the password
OAuth Apps Overview Account OAuth Apps Organization OAuth Apps OAuth Token API REST API: OAuth App resource

decisions.reason: Twilio's own docs show Basic auth using an API key SID/secret, plus a dedicated OAuth Apps/OAuth Token API section, so both agents' three methods are confirmed on-page.

evidence.snippet: Trial accounts expire 30 days after sign-up. When your trial expires, you can no longer use trial resources.
Start for free. Then pay as you go.

decisions.reason: The free trial is explicitly time-limited (30 days, restricted recipients/content) and the pricing page confirms ongoing usage requires moving to pay-as-you-go, so paid plan is the real friction for sustained building.

evidence.snippet: You can sign up for a Twilio free trial account without a credit card. Trial accounts expire after 30 days.
You must use Twilio-provided templates or message examples. Custom message bodies, email content, and WhatsApp templates aren't available during the trial.

decisions.reason: A developer can self-serve a working trial account and build against the documented REST API today, but trial expiration, verified-recipient limits, and template restrictions are real caveats before production use.

evidence.snippet: The server is hosted by Twilio at mcp.twilio.com/docs

decisions.reason: Twilio's own documentation at twilio.com/docs/ai/mcp states the MCP server is hosted by Twilio at mcp.twilio.com/docs, confirming it is an official vendor-published MCP server.
